author: SeverinDiederichs
body:
This updates G4HepEm to the latest version.

Note: this will change the physics output, as this improves the Woodcock tracking to do one less step when exiting a Woodcock tracking volume, and furthermore the multiple MSC steps per transport step are improved and give now results closer to the normal transportation.

A second PR for the g4adept line was also opened here: #10991 

@civanch @kpedro88
title: Update G4HepEm to 20261106
